bodyHtml:
🎮 PlayStation, Xbox & Switch · Logan & Surrounds

Console Repairs Logan. Get Back To Gaming, Fast.

Whether it's your PS5, Xbox or Switch, don't let a broken console stop you. Computer Repairs Logan has partnered with a trusted console repair specialist so you get expert technicians, genuine parts and comprehensive warranties on PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch repairs, with a short turnaround so you can get back to gaming.

Fix My Console
✓ Genuine Parts
✓ Micro-Soldering & Board-Level Diagnostics
✓ Warranty Included
✓ 24-48hr Turnaround, Same-Day Available
PlayStation Console Repairs

PS5, PS4 & PS3 Repair Solutions.

🔌

HDMI Port Replacement

For display and video output issues on any PlayStation model.

🔵

Blue Light Of Death

Full diagnostic and repair for the PS5's dreaded blue light fault.

💿

Disc Drive & Laser Repair

Disc read errors, optical drive faults and laser replacement across PS5, PS4 and PS3.

🌡️

Overheating & Fan Issues

Thermal paste replacement, fan cleaning and replacement for overheating consoles.

⚡

Power & Motherboard Issues

Power supply problems, "no power" diagnostics and component-level motherboard repair.

🎮

Controller Repairs

DualSense and DualShock port, charging and stick drift repairs.

Xbox Console Repairs

Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One & 360 Repairs.

🔌

HDMI & Retimer IC Repairs

For display and signal issues on Series X|S consoles.

🟩

Green Screen Of Death

Diagnostics and permanent fixes for the Xbox Series X|S GSOD fault.

🔴

Red Ring Of Death

Professional repair service for the classic Xbox 360 fault.

💿

Disc Tray & Drive Repair

Solutions for optical drive and read-error issues across all Xbox generations.

🌡️

Overheating Solutions

Advanced thermal management and cooling system maintenance.

📶

Connectivity Repairs

WiFi antenna, USB port and controller connectivity fixes.

Complex issues like power surges, liquid damage and motherboard failures that other shops consider unrepairable are also handled, using professional diagnostic equipment and micro-soldering.

Nintendo Switch Repairs

Switch, Switch OLED, Switch Lite, Wii & DS.

  • Joy-Con Drift. Professional repair service.
  • Charging Port Damage. USB-C port replacement.
  • Screen Replacement. For cracked or damaged LCD/OLED displays.
  • Battery Replacement. Solves power management issues.
  • Game Card Slot Repair. Fixes cartridge read errors.
  • Dock & HDMI Issues. Repair for TV connectivity problems.
  • Kickstand & Rail Repair. For Joy-Con connection issues.
  • Overheating & Motherboard. Thermal solutions and micro-soldering for complex faults.
Storage & Performance

Storage Expansion & SSD Upgrades.

Supercharge your gameplay with faster load times.

  • Internal SSD Expansion. Professional installation of M.2 NVMe SSDs with heat sinks for PS5.
  • External Storage Options. Setup and configuration of USB 3.0 external drives.
  • HDD To SSD Conversions. Upgrade PS4 and Xbox One internal drives for faster load times.
  • Legacy Console Storage. Hard drive replacement and capacity expansion for PS3, Xbox 360 and Wii.
Fix My Console
Frequently Asked Questions

Console Repair Questions, Answered.

How long does a console repair take?

Most repairs are completed within 24-48 hours, with same-day service available for urgent gaming needs.

Do console repairs come with a warranty?

Yes, all repair work is backed by a comprehensive warranty, using genuine replacement parts.

Which consoles do you repair?

PlayStation 5, 4 and 3, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Xbox 360, and Nintendo Switch, Switch OLED, Switch Lite, Wii and DS.

Is a diagnostic free before I commit to a repair?

Yes, pricing is transparent with no hidden fees, and diagnostics are free before you decide to go ahead.

Can you fix issues other shops call unrepairable?

Often, yes, complex faults like power surges, liquid damage and motherboard failures are handled using professional diagnostic equipment and micro-soldering techniques.

Related Services

Console Fixed, What Else Can We Help With?

Not sure whether the fault's your console or your home network? Our hardware repair & diagnostics service can help pin it down. If a drive failure has put game saves or media at risk, see data recovery. For everything else computer-related, check our computer repairs page.

Don't Let A Broken Console Stop You.

Get a professional, guaranteed repair for any PlayStation, Xbox or Switch issue. Free, no-obligation quote.
